mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zabbix.sla_fault_category ( id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, fault_category VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '故障类别', fault_subcategory VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '故障子类', fault_desc VARCHAR(512) NULL COMMENT '故障描述（说明）', count_sla VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL COMMENT '是否计算SLA：是/否', sort_order INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE KEY uk_fault_cat (fault_category, fault_subcategory) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='复盘明细-故障分类字典'

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zabbix.sla_review_event ( id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, period_month CHAR(6) NOT NULL COMMENT 'yyyyMM，对齐复盘明细-yyyyMM', system_level VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL COMMENT '父/子系统', system_name VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL COMMENT '系统名称', down_start DATETIME NOT NULL COMMENT '宕机开始时间', down_end DATETIME NULL COMMENT '宕机结束时间', exclude_time DATETIME NULL COMMENT '排除结束时间', owner_name VARCHAR(64) NULL COMMENT '责任人', fault_category VARCHAR(64) NULL COMMENT '故障类别', fault_subcategory VARCHAR(64) NULL COMMENT '故障子类', fault_desc VARCHAR(512) NULL COMMENT '故障描述', count_sla VARCHAR(8) NULL COMMENT '是否计算SLA', resolution_process TEXT NULL COMMENT '解决过程', root_cause TEXT NULL COMMENT '根本原因', improvement TEXT NULL COMMENT '改进措施', created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE KEY uk_event (period_month, system_level, system_name, down_start, down_end) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='复盘明细-故障录入'

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zabbix.sla_system_owner ( id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, system_level VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL COMMENT '子系统/父系统', system_name VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL COMMENT '系统名称', owner_name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '责任人', mobile VARCHAR(32) NULL COMMENT '手机号码', monitor_edition VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT '老版监控' COMMENT '老版监控/新版监控', write_jdbc_key VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'zabbix6' COMMENT 'zabbix6/zabbix7', created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE KEY uk_system_owner (system_level, system_name) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='系统责任人字典'

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zabbix.sla_sli_snapshot ( id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, report_year INT NOT NULL COMMENT '看板年，同步时 Asia/Shanghai 日历年', system_level VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL COMMENT '父系统/子系统', system_name VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL COMMENT '系统名称', panel_id INT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Grafana 面板 id', panel_name VARCHAR(64) NULL COMMENT '老版/新版', sli_annual DECIMAL(10,4) NULL COMMENT '年度SLI', sli_m01 DECIMAL(10,4) NULL, sli_m02 DECIMAL(10,4) NULL, sli_m03 DECIMAL(10,4) NULL, sli_m04 DECIMAL(10,4) NULL, sli_m05 DECIMAL(10,4) NULL, sli_m06 DECIMAL(10,4) NULL, sli_m07 DECIMAL(10,4) NULL, sli_m08 DECIMAL(10,4) NULL, sli_m09 DECIMAL(10,4) NULL, sli_m10 DECIMAL(10,4) NULL, sli_m11 DECIMAL(10,4) NULL, sli_m12 DECIMAL(10,4) NULL, synced_at DATETIME NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE KEY uk_sli_snapshot (report_year, system_level, system_name, panel_id) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='父子 SLA 看板日更快照'
